metadata.description: Partial checklist for EIP-specific opcodes and system operations (batch 9)

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7251 consolidation request edges enforce 96-byte input validation and fee payment
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EIP-7251 consolidation request processing in core/vm/contracts.go or system contract implementation
2. Verify input length validation enforces exactly 96 bytes (two 48-byte BLS pubkeys):
a. Source validator pubkey (48 bytes)
b. Target validator pubkey (48 bytes)
3. Verify fee payment validation at CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS (0x01...)
4. Check exponential fee mechanism matches EIP spec for spam prevention
5. Verify max 2 consolidation requests per block enforcement
6. Check queue insertion only after both input and fee validation pass
7. Verify edge transitions match EDGE-7251-VALIDATE -> EDGE-7251-CHECK-FEE -> EDGE-7251-ENQUEUE
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP7251-EDGES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-7251-CONSOLIDATIONS edges. Prague+ feature. 96-byte input = source + target pubkeys. Fee mechanism prevents spam.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2935 parent block hash storage in system contract with ring buffer
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EIP-2935 BLOCKHASH history contract at HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS (0x0F...)
2. Verify system call execution at block start (before transactions)
3. Check ring buffer implementation:
a. HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW = 8191 slots
b. Slot calculation: (block.number - 1) % 8191
4. Verify parent block hash is stored at computed slot
5. Check BLOCKHASH opcode retrieval from contract storage for recent blocks
6. Verify hash integrity - stored hash matches actual parent block hash
7. Confirm nodes STATE-2935-BLOCK-START -> ACTION-2935-SYSTEM-CALL -> ACTION-2935-COMPUTE-SLOT -> ACTION-2935-STORE-HASH path
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP2935-NODES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-2935-BLOCKHASH-STATE nodes. Cryptographic guarantee: block hash is commitment to header.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2935 edges enforce system call timing and ring buffer indexing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block processing in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify EDGE-2935-SYSTEM-CALL executes before any user transactions
3. Check edge flow: EDGE-2935-SYSTEM-CALL -> EDGE-2935-COMPUTE -> EDGE-2935-STORE -> EDGE-2935-COMPLETE
4. Verify slot computation precedes storage operation
5. Check query path: EDGE-2935-QUERY -> EDGE-2935-RETURN for BLOCKHASH retrieval
6. Verify no transaction can observe stale block hash data
7. Confirm system call cannot be skipped or reordered

executable_checks.assertion: System call processing exists in state processor
Transaction ordering vs system calls documented

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP2935-EDGES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-2935-BLOCKHASH-STATE edges. System call must execute before transactions.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7939 CLZ opcode implements correct count leading zeros semantics
detection_procedure: 1. Locate CLZ opcode implementation in core/vm/instructions.go (Osaka+)
2. Verify CLZ formula: result = 256 - x.BitLen() for 256-bit value x
3. Check edge cases:
a. CLZ(0) = 256 (all zeros)
b. CLZ(2^255) = 0 (MSB set)
4. Verify stack operation: in-place modification of stack top (peek-modify pattern)
5. Confirm nodes: STATE-7939-OPCODE-START -> ACTION-7939-PEEK-VALUE -> ACTION-7939-COMPUTE-CLZ -> ACTION-7939-SET-RESULT
6. Verify no stack underflow possible
7. Check result is correctly bounded [0, 256]
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP7939-NODES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-7939-CLZ nodes. Osaka+ EIP. Result = 256 - BitLen(x).

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7939 CLZ edges enforce gas-first execution with GasFastStep charge
detection_procedure: 1. Locate CLZ gas cost in core/vm/gas_table.go or jump_table.go
2. Verify gas cost is GasFastStep = 5
3. Check edge flow: EDGE-7939-GAS -> EDGE-7939-PEEK -> EDGE-7939-COMPUTE -> EDGE-7939-SET -> EDGE-7939-DONE
4. Verify gas is charged BEFORE computation (gas-first semantics)
5. Confirm insufficient gas causes execution failure without stack modification
6. Verify dynamic gas component is zero (static cost only)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP7939-EDGES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-7939-CLZ edges. GasFastStep = 5. Gas-first execution.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2929 cold/warm access tracking and gas pricing implementation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate access list tracking in core/state/statedb.go (accessList or similar)
2. Verify cold access costs:
a. COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_COST = 2600 gas
b. COLD_SLOAD_COST = 2100 gas
3. Verify warm access cost: WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST = 100 gas
4. Check access list initialization at transaction start (STATE-2929-TX-START)
5. Verify EIP-2930 transaction access list pre-warming
6. Confirm cold address/slot is marked warm after first access
7. Check revert behavior: access lists revert with state on call failure
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP2929-NODES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-2929-GAS-ACCESS nodes. Berlin+ feature. Cold=2100-2600, warm=100 gas.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2929 edges enforce cold/warm check before gas charging
detection_procedure: 1. Trace SLOAD, SSTORE, BALANCE, EXTCODE* opcodes in core/vm/
2. Verify edge flow: check cold/warm -> charge appropriate gas -> mark warm
3. Confirm EDGE-2929-ACCOUNT-CHECK precedes EDGE-2929-COLD-ACCOUNT or EDGE-2929-WARM-ACCOUNT
4. Verify slot-level tracking: EDGE-2929-SLOAD-CHECK -> EDGE-2929-COLD-SLOAD or EDGE-2929-WARM-SLOAD
5. Check address is added to warm set only after gas successfully charged
6. Verify revert restores access list state (EDGE-2929-SCOPE-REVERT)
7. Confirm no path allows cold access at warm price
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP2929-EDGES-001 -> GRAPH-EIP-2929-GAS-ACCESS edges. Check precedes charge. Cold marked warm after first access.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-3855 PUSH0 opcode execution path from start to completion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PUSH0 implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify opcode value is 0x5F (Shanghai+)
3. Check node execution path:
a. STATE-PUSH0-START: opcode fetch and decode
b. ACTION-PUSH0-CHARGE-GAS: charge GasQuickStep = 2
c. ACTION-PUSH0-PUSH-ZERO: push 0 onto stack
d. STATE-PUSH0-COMPLETE: increment PC by 1
4. Verify stack overflow check (stack.len() < 1024)
5. Confirm zero value is pushed as full 256-bit zero
6. Verify no memory allocation or state access occurs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-NODES-EXACT-001 -> STATE-PUSH0-START. Shanghai+ EIP. Linear execution path.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-3855 PUSH0 edge transitions enforce correct execution order
detection_procedure: 1. Trace PUSH0 execution in EVM interpreter loop (core/vm/interpreter.go)
2. Verify edge sequence: EDGE-PUSH0-GAS -> EDGE-PUSH0-EXEC -> EDGE-PUSH0-DONE
3. Confirm gas charging occurs before stack push
4. Verify insufficient gas causes failure before any stack modification
5. Check edge EDGE-PUSH0-DONE advances program counter correctly
6. Verify no alternative paths bypass gas check
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-EDGES-EXACT-001 -> EDGE-PUSH0-EXEC. Sequential edge transitions enforced.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT same-transaction destruction semantics
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SELFDESTRUCT implementation in core/vm/instructions.go (opSelfdestruct)
2. Verify StateDB.Created() check for same-transaction creation
3. Check node flow:
a. STATE-SD6780-START: SELFDESTRUCT opcode entry
b. ACTION-SD6780-POP-BENEFICIARY: pop beneficiary address
c. ACTION-SD6780-TRANSFER-BALANCE: transfer remaining balance
d. ACTION-SD6780-CHECK-CREATED-SAME-TX: query Created() flag
e. ACTION-SD6780-DESTROY-CONTRACT: if same-tx, mark for destruction
f. STATE-SD6780-NO-DESTROY: if different-tx, skip destruction
4. Verify contract code is NOT removed for pre-existing contracts
5. Confirm balance transfer occurs regardless of creation time
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-SD6780-NODES-001 -> STATE-SD6780-START. Cancun+ EIP. Only same-tx creation allows destruction.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT edges correctly branch on same-transaction check
detection_procedure: 1. Trace SELFDESTRUCT execution path in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify edge EDGE-SD6780-CHECK is the branch point
3. Confirm two distinct paths:
a. EDGE-SD6780-SAME-TX -> ACTION-SD6780-DESTROY-CONTRACT -> EDGE-SD6780-DESTROY-DONE
b. EDGE-SD6780-DIFF-TX -> STATE-SD6780-NO-DESTROY -> EDGE-SD6780-NO-DESTROY-DONE
4. Verify Created() flag correctly reflects in-transaction creation
5. Check balance transfer (EDGE-SD6780-POP, EDGE-SD6780-TRANSFER) occurs before check
6. Verify no edge transition allows destruction without same-tx verification
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-SD6780-EDGES-001 -> EDGE-SD6780-CHECK. Path divergence based on Created() flag.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-4844 BLOBHASH opcode returns versioned hash or zero for out-of-bounds
detection_procedure: 1. Locate BLOBHASH (0x49) implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify node execution:
a. STATE-BLOBHASH-START: opcode entry
b. ACTION-BLOBHASH-CHARGE-GAS: charge GasExtStep = 20
c. ACTION-BLOBHASH-PEEK-INDEX: peek index from stack
d. ACTION-BLOBHASH-CHECK-BOUNDS: check index < len(tx.BlobHashes)
e. ACTION-BLOBHASH-GET-HASH: if valid, return BlobHashes[index]
f. ACTION-BLOBHASH-PUSH-ZERO: if invalid, return 0
3. Verify versioned hash format (0x01 prefix + KZG commitment hash)
4. Confirm no panic on out-of-bounds access
5. Check blob hashes are available from transaction context
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-BLOBHASH-NODES-001 -> STATE-BLOBHASH-START. Cancun+ EIP. Returns versioned hash or zero. KZG commitment verified by CL.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-4844 BLOBHASH edges enforce gas and bounds checking
detection_procedure: 1. Trace BLOBHASH execution in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify edge sequence:
a. EDGE-BLOBHASH-GAS: gas charged first
b. EDGE-BLOBHASH-INDEX: index peeked from stack
c. EDGE-BLOBHASH-BOUNDS: bounds validation
3. Check branch paths:
a. EDGE-BLOBHASH-VALID -> EDGE-BLOBHASH-DONE: in-bounds access
b. EDGE-BLOBHASH-ZERO -> EDGE-BLOBHASH-DONE1: out-of-bounds returns zero
4. Verify gas is charged regardless of bounds outcome
5. Confirm no path accesses array without bounds check
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-BLOBHASH-EDGES-001 -> EDGE-BLOBHASH-INDEX. All paths enforce gas charging first.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-1153 TSTORE fails in static call context
detection_procedure: 1. Locate TSTORE (0x5D) implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify STATE-TSTORE-WRITE-PROTECTED checks interpreter.readOnly flag
3. Confirm static call context causes immediate failure with write protection error
4. Check failure occurs before any transient storage modification
5. Verify error message indicates static call violation
6. Confirm TSTORE succeeds in non-static context
7. Check node transitions: if readonly -> fail, else -> proceed to ACTION-TSTORE-POP-KEY-VALUE
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP1153-TSTORE-NODES-001 -> STATE-TSTORE-WRITE-PROTECTED. Cancun+ EIP. Static call protection.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-1153 TSTORE readonly check edge leads to fail path in static context
detection_procedure: 1. Trace TSTORE execution from entry point in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify EDGE-TSTORE-RO-CHECK is the first validation edge
3. Confirm edge transition to EDGE-TSTORE-RO-FAIL when interpreter.readOnly == true
4. Verify failure path does not modify transient storage
5. Check normal path continues to gas charging and storage write
6. Verify EVM enforces static call restrictions consistently
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP1153-TSTORE-EDGES-001 -> EDGE-TSTORE-RO-CHECK. EVM enforces static call restrictions.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-5656 MCOPY stack operations pop dest, src, length correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Locate MCOPY (0x5E) implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify EDGE-MCOPY-POP pops three values in correct order:
a. First pop: destination offset
b. Second pop: source offset
c. Third pop: length
3. Check edge sequence: EDGE-MCOPY-POP -> EDGE-MCOPY-START -> EDGE-MCOPY-GAS -> EDGE-MCOPY-MEM
4. Verify memory expansion gas is calculated after stack pop
5. Confirm EDGE-MCOPY-EXEC performs the actual memory copy
6. Verify EDGE-MCOPY-DONE completes execution
7. Check overlapping region handling (memmove semantics)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP5656-MCOPY-EDGES-EXACT-001 -> EDGE-MCOPY-POP. Cancun+ EIP. Stack order: dest, src, length.

checklist.title: Verify complete TSTORE execution includes readonly check, gas, and storage set
detection_procedure: 1. Trace complete TSTORE execution path in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify ACTION-TSTORE-CHECK-READONLY occurs first
3. Confirm ACTION-TSTORE-CHARGE-GAS charges correct gas (WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST = 100)
4. Verify ACTION-TSTORE-SET-VALUE writes to transient storage map
5. Check EDGE-TSTORE-SET transitions to completion state
6. Verify transient storage is transaction-scoped (cleared at tx end)
7. Confirm no persistent state modification occurs
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP1153-TSTORE-FULL-001 -> ACTION-TSTORE-CHECK-READONLY. Transaction-scoped semantics.

checklist.title: Verify complete TLOAD execution reads from transient storage correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Locate TLOAD (0x5C) implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify execution path:
a. ACTION-TLOAD-CHARGE-GAS: charge WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST = 100
b. ACTION-TLOAD-PEEK-KEY: peek storage key from stack
c. ACTION-TLOAD-GET-VALUE: retrieve from transient storage
3. Check EDGE-TLOAD-KEY -> EDGE-TLOAD-GET transitions
4. Verify return value is zero if key not set
5. Confirm TLOAD reads from transient storage, NOT persistent storage
6. Verify no readonly check needed (TLOAD is read-only by nature)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP1153-TLOAD-FULL-001 -> ACTION-TLOAD-PEEK-KEY. Must read transient, not persistent storage.

checklist.title: Verify BLOBHASH returns zero for out-of-bounds index without error
detection_procedure: 1. Locate BLOBHASH out-of-bounds handling in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify ACTION-BLOBHASH-RETURN-ZERO returns exactly 256-bit zero
3. Check EDGE-BLOBHASH-DONE2 completes out-of-bounds path normally
4. Confirm no error or panic is raised for invalid index
5. Verify gas is still consumed for out-of-bounds access
6. Check behavior matches EIP-4844 specification
7. Confirm index comparison handles uint256 correctly
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-BLOBHASH-FULL-001 -> ACTION-BLOBHASH-RETURN-ZERO. No panic or error. Zero returned for OOB.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2935 block hash query returns correct hash from ring buffer
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EIP-2935 BLOCKHASH query path in core/vm/ or system contract
2. Verify STATE-2935-HASH-RETURNED represents successful completion
3. Check ring buffer lookup:
a. Compute slot: requested_block_number % 8191
b. Read stored hash from system contract storage
4. Verify returned hash matches actual block hash for requested number
5. Check behavior for blocks outside HISTORY_SERVE_WINDOW (8191)
6. Confirm cryptographic integrity: hash is commitment to block header
7. Verify query cannot return stale or incorrect hash
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP2935-HASH-RETURNED-001 -> STATE-2935-HASH-RETURNED. Ring buffer ensures correct hash for recent blocks. Cryptographic commitment.
